solidping.description: SolidPing uptime monitoring: list and create checks across 40+ check types (HTTP, DNS, TCP, SSL, databases, queues, heartbeats), read results and incidents, diagnose a failing check, and manage status pages. Streamable HTTP, OAuth sign-in in the browser. Hosted with a free tier, or self-hosted at https://<your-host>/api/v1/mcp.
